Hi, I'm Robin, Licensed Massage & Bodywork Therapist and Certified Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercise® Provider. This channel is my space to share educational videos and peeks into what my real treatments look like. You'll find therapy videos, unintentional asmr, aromatherapy tutorials, reactions, self-care practices, and TRE®. 

My clinic in western North Carolina has some availability for in-person appointments, and I provide Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises® appointments via Zoom. Reach out at wildsunbodywork@gmail.com

~ New videos every Wednesday at 3 pm eastern standard time ~

NC LMBT #23605

**Watching YouTube videos and participating in guided self-care routines is not a substitute for medical advice from your physician or hands-on treatment from a licensed therapist, and does not establish a therapist-client relationship. If you’ve got a condition or injury, consult your healthcare providers~ that’s what we’re here for!
